==English==
{{wp}}
[[File:Lizard Collage.jpg|thumb|Diversity of lizards (sense 1)]]
[[File:Lizard symbol in Rock-paper-scissors-lizard-Spock.svg|thumb|(sense 5)]]

===Etymology===
From {{inh|en|enm|lesarde}}, {{m|enm|lisarde}}, from {{der|en|xno|lusard}}, from {{der|en|fro|lesard}} (compare {{cog|fr|lézard}}), from {{der|en|la|lacertus}}, which is of obscure origin. Displaced native {{ncog|enm|aske}}, from {{ncog|ang|āþexe}} (> modern {{noncog|en|ask|id=lizard}}, {{m|en|askard}}).

===Pronunciation===
* {{a|en|non-rhotic}}
** {{IPA|en|/ˈlɪzəd/|[ˈlɪzəd]|a=RP,SSB,AU}}
** {{IPA|en|/ˈləzəd/|[ˈləzəd]|a=NZ}}
* {{a|en|rhotic}}
** {{IPA|en|/ˈlɪzɚd/|[ˈlɪzɚd]|~|[ˈlɪzɹ̩d]|a=GA}}
*** {{audio|en|en-us-lizard.ogg|a=US}}
** {{IPA|en|/ˈlɪzəɾd/|[ˈlɪzəɾd]|a=Scotland}}
* {{rhymes|en|ɪzə(ɹ)d|s=2}}
* {{hyph|en|liz|ard}}

===Noun===
{{en-noun}}

# Any reptile of the order {{taxfmt|Squamata|order}} that is not a [[snake]] or [[mosasaur]]—typically characterised by a rounded torso, a short neck with an elevated head, a long tail and four limbs, although some species are legless.
#* {{RQ:Shelley Posthumous Poems|poem=Hymn of Pan|page=169|text=The cicale above in the lime, / And the '''lizards''' below in the grass, / Were as silent as ever old Tmolus was, / Listening to my sweet pipings.}}
#* {{RQ:Ruskin Stones of Venice|volume=I|chapter=XX|section=XXX|pages=223–224|pageref=223|passage=The forms of the serpent and '''lizard''' exhibit almost every element of beauty and horror in strange combination; {{...}}}}
#* {{RQ:Powell Colorado|I|22|Hooded rattlesnakes, horned toads, and '''lizards''' crawl in the dust and among the rocks.}}
#* {{quote-book|en|year=1961|author={{w|Harry E. Wedeck}}|title=Dictionary of Aphrodisiacs|publisher=The Citadel Press|location=New York|page=139|passage=When held in the hand, the '''lizard''' produces an amorous stimulus.}}
# {{lb|en|chiefly|in [[attributive]] use}} Lizard skin, the [[skin]] of these reptiles.
#* {{quote-book|en|date=October 28 1990|author=w:Paul Simon|chapter=Proof|title=w:The Rhythm of the Saints|publisher=Warner Bros.
|passage=Silver bells jingling from your black '''lizard''' boots, my baby / Silver foil to trim your wedding gown}}
# {{lb|en|[[cladistically]]}} Any reptile of the order {{taxfmt|Squamata|order}}, including [[snake]]s.
#: {{ux|en|Scientifically, snakes are '''lizards'''.}}
# {{lb|en|colloquial}} An [[unctuous]] person.
# {{lb|en|colloquial}} A coward.
# {{lb|en|rock paper scissors}} A [[hand]] forming a "D" shape with the tips of the thumb and index finger touching (a [[handshape]] resembling a lizard), that beats [[paper]] and [[Spock]] and loses to [[rock]] and [[scissors]] in [[rock-paper-scissors-lizard-Spock]].
# {{lb|en|in compounds}} A person who idly spends time in a specified place, especially a promiscuous woman.
#: {{ux|en|lounge '''lizard'''; lot '''lizard'''; beach '''lizard'''; truck stop '''lizard'''}}
